meta.metaDescription: Alternatives to Trump Accounts: 529, custodial Roth IRA, UTMA, Coverdell, savings, I bonds. See which fits your goal, plus who else can fund an account.

reader_question: What are the alternatives to a Trump Account?
answer: A 529 plan is the usual first alternative for education savings; a custodial brokerage, custodial Roth IRA, Coverdell ESA, savings account or I bonds fit other goals.
